newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen cuts Arterial Vascular.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen cuts Arterial Vascular.

text.p: -- Cowen Friday cut Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc to buy from strong buy.
-- Arterial Vascular dropped sharply by seven to 9-5/8 in morning trading.

-- After the market closed Thursday, Arterial Vascular said it expects to earn $0.14 to $0.16 a share for the second quarter ending December 31 -- a drop from earnings of $0.25 a share in the first quarter.
-- The company cited higher-than-expected expenses and pricing pressure for the second quarter earnings shortfall.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
